src: maroon occlusion mask over a shifted two-axis reflection pattern with matching edge quarter-turn bands
transform: replace each maroon pixel with the unique non-maroon color from its horizontal/vertical reflection orbit; if that orbit is fully occluded or outside the shifted mirror domain, use the unique same-center quarter-turn counterpart
multi_step: infer the occluding color and shifted row/column axes from non-maroon consistency, then repair reflection orbits before quarter-turn edge leftovers
